entities.summary: Carmel Agius is a Maltese judge who served as a judge of the International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia from 2001 to 2017 and its president from 2015 to 2017. He has also served as a judge of the International Residual Mechanism for Criminal Tribunals since 2012 and its president from 2019 to 2022.
